record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: For the trigonometric Abel differential equations ẋ = (a₀ + a₁ sin t + a₂ cos t)x³ + (b₀ + b₁ sin t + b₂ cos t)x², determine whether the maximum possible number of 2π-periodic limit cycles is 3.

evidence.quote: Problem 6. Consider the family of trigonometric Abel diﬀerential equations dx/dt = (a0 +a1 sint +a2 cost)x3 + (b0 +b1 sint +b2 cost)x2. Is 3 its maximum number of 2πperiodic limit cycles?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of Abel differential equations on the cylinder $(t,x)\in\mathbb{R}/2\pi\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{R}$ given by
$$\frac{dx}{dt}=(a_0+a_1\sin t+a_2\cos t)\,x^3+(b_0+b_1\sin t+b_2\cos t)\,x^2,$$
where $a_0,a_1,a_2,b_0,b_1,b_2\in\mathbb{R}$ are real parameters. A limit cycle is an isolated $2\pi$-periodic solution $x(t)$ of this equation (counted in the space of $2\pi$-periodic solutions, including the trivial solution $x\equiv 0$ when isolated). Determine whether, over all choices of the parameters $a_i,b_i$, the maximum number of $2\pi$-periodic limit cycles of this family is exactly $3$.
artifact.category_tag: Abel differential equations and limit cycles
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (published in J. Differential Equations, 2024, "Maximum number of limit cycles for Abel equation having coefficients with linear trigonometric functions") establishes that for Abel equations with linear trigonometric coefficients the maximum number of limit cycles is three, providing a positive answer to the problem.

status_evidence.title: Maximum number of limit cycles for Abel equation having coefficients with linear trigonometric functions
status_evidence.snippet: For Abel equations where coefficients are linear trigonometric functions, the maximum number of limit cycles is three, providing a positive answer to an open problem proposed by Gasull.
status_evidence.claim: The maximum number of 2π-periodic limit cycles for the trigonometric Abel equation with linear trigonometric coefficients equals 3.

status_evidence.title: Rational solutions and limit cycles of polynomial and trigonometric Abel equations
status_evidence.snippet: Rational solutions of Abel trigonometric polynomial differential equations and bounds on limit cycles.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work confirms bounds on limit cycles of trigonometric Abel equations consistent with the value 3 in the linear case.
